# sendgrid_list (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid Marketing Campaigns contact list by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_list" "newsletter" {
  id = "ca7a3796-e8a8-4029-9ccb-df8937940562"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The list's UUID.

### Read-Only

- `contact_count` (Number) The number of contacts currently on this list.
- `name` (String) The list's name.
